perl_cache: none: variant_recoder reads the Ensembl database (--db_version 116)
fasta: none on the Ensembl VEP side (the slice sequence comes from the database); reference.fa.gz on the vep-rs side
input: the eight variants of the GRCh38-input-id corpus that are neither failed in dbSNP nor co-located with a COSMIC or HGMD-PUBLIC variant, each written as an identifier (variants.id.txt, one of them in upper case as well), as HGVS notations (variants.hgvs.txt), as SPDI notations (variants.spdi.txt) and as a VCF record (variants.recode.vcf); the failed variants are left out because variant_recoder --var_synonyms stops with an error on a failed variant, as it does on a VCF input, whose case carries no --var_synonyms; the variants with a co-located COSMIC or HGMD-PUBLIC variant are left out because those identifiers are not redistributed
vep_rs_command: vep recode -i <input> --json_cache json_cache --fasta reference.fa.gz --synonyms chr_synonyms.txt <the case's args>
tool_cases_generator: scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus tests/golden/116/GRCh38-recoder --tool variant_recoder; every case connects variant_recoder to the public Ensembl database (its perl_args, --db_version 116), the mode the tool runs in by construction
reference: reference.fa.gz is GRCh38 chromosome 21 (Ensembl release 116 primary assembly) with every base outside 2,000 bases of a record of variants.recode.vcf or of the GRCh38-input-id corpus's variants.vcf masked to N, bgzip-compressed with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form
chr_synonyms: chr_synonyms.txt: the six lines of the Ensembl GRCh38 cache's chr_synonyms.txt that link chromosome 21's names (21, chr21, NC_000021.9, CM000683.2) to one another, copied whole; json_cache holds no chr_synonyms.txt of its own (the one the prune command writes beside the shards is left out), so the cases of crates/vep-cli/tests/recode_tool.rs that pass no --synonyms read a cache without one, and the accession is what HGVSg, SPDI and the GA4GH VRS allele are named by
cache: json_cache: the GRCh38-input-id corpus's transcripts, pruned to the records of both corpora, with a variation slice of the Ensembl release-116 GRCh38 cache

variation_slice.source: homo_sapiens/116_GRCh38/21/all_vars.gz of the Ensembl VEP release-116 indexed cache
variation_slice.window: records whose start lies within 2,000 bases of a record of variants.recode.vcf or of the GRCh38-input-id corpus's variants.vcf

comparison: tools/vep-formats-compare --format recoder --masks refseq_transcript_entries,lrg_transcript_entries,archive_dbsnp_synonyms,identifier_indel_transcript_notations; the last two name the Archive dbSNP synonyms the cache's column never holds and the transcript notations variant_recoder leaves unshifted for an identifier input's insertions and deletions
